this_court: Evidence obtained in violation of 8 U.S.C. § 1357(a) is not suppressed, because the statute creates no exclusionary remedy and the court declines to create a judicial one.
quote: We find these authorities persuasive and decline to create a circuit split.
cite: United States v. Marcio Santos-Portillo, 997 F.3d 159 (4th Cir. 2021)
